speech.heard: East Timor hits 76.2% for male tobacco use. Nigeria stays down at 5.8%. East Timor is the highest of all 163 countries and territories on the globe. Nigeria sits at the bottom with 5.8%. East Timor has 13 times what Nigeria has. China stands at 44.2% and India at 35.6%. It counts anyone ages 15 and over who uses smoked or smokeless tobacco. The median across the globe is 26.4%. How common is male tobacco use where you live?
